summary: Allen Peak lookout, Yell County, Arkansas: CCC-built 1933, removed 1972; 1956 survey gives a conflicting 48 ft height. No site description today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1933 note gives a 30-foot tower (about 9.1 m, the value kept in the record). The 1956 survey description says the tower is 48 feet high. The sources do not reconcile the two, so the story reports both.
The 1933 note describes a CCC-built wood cab on a tower; the 1956 survey calls the tower a standard steel Forest Service lookout. Both are reported in the story, not merged.

notes_for_editor: Two sources. Source 1 is one web page that also reproduces the Coast and Geodetic Survey station description, so the survey is not independent of the page. Web searches (two) found no separate mention of an Allen Peak lookout in Yell County or of the 1972 removal. Height and construction disagree between the 1933 note (30-foot tower, wood cab) and the 1956 survey (48 feet, standard steel); the story reports both and the record keeps 9.1 m. No site description today and no photos. Brief lat/lon (34.85287, -93.46963) was not checked against any second source.
